questions.question: What happened to Jeremiah after his temple sermon in chapter 26?
options: He fled away to the land of Egypt to escape from his enemies
The people made him a great leader over the whole of the city
The priests and prophets seized him, saying he deserved death
The king rewarded him richly with much gold and with great honor
questions.answer: The priests and prophets seized him, saying he deserved death

questions.question: Which other prophet, who prophesied like Jeremiah, was killed by King Jehoiakim?
Ahikam son of Shaphan protected Jeremiah so he was not handed over to be put to death.
